labels.description: Tensor of shape [batch, max value in seq_length]

seq_length.description: Tensor of shape [batch], sequence length of each batch element.

output.description: A tuple `(collapsed_labels, new_seq_length)` where Tensor of shape [batch, max_seq_length] with repeated labels collapsed and padded to max_seq_length, eg: `[[A, A, B, B, A], [A, B, C, D, E]] => [[A, B, A, 0, 0], [A, B, C, D, E]]` new_seq_length: int tensor of shape [batch] with new sequence lengths.
